answer:30de28f2-d413-41cd-814a-2b6881661: Yes. All connections use TLS 1.2 or higher. Older protocol versions are disabled at the load balancer.
answer:22b3e906-1d46-4f8c-adbb-c8f97d374: Infrastructure and container images are scanned weekly. Critical findings are fixed within 7 days and high findings within 30 days.
